Manifest.Name: 原版枪械拓展 Vanilla Gun Expansion
Manifest.Author: KlN
Manifest.Description: 原版枪械与店铺经营拓展：框架、配件和成品弹药芯片，打印机芯片库与自动供料、自动入库，六款外观的可扩容枪柜，以及改枪与维修。散装弹每份五发，可拆封的弹药盒装满八份。街头冲突、买枪客口碑、名枪来历和保养、佣兵枪械回售、喷漆贴纸、收藏家订单和上层区枪匠预约。含「隐秘行动」剧情与奥丁的中英文说明书。卸载或停用前请清空芯片库与枪柜；开过金属锭配方的话先关掉，读档后再存一次。 / Expands the vanilla gunsmith trade with frame, attachment and finished-ammunition chips, printer chip racks, auto feed and auto stock, expandable six-style gun cabinets, fitting and repairs. Loose ammunition comes in five-round handfuls; reusable boxes hold eight. Adds street clashes, gun buyer reputation, famous gun history and upkeep, mercenary reoffers, paint and stickers, collector orders and upper-level gunsmith bookings. Includes the Covert Operation side story and Odin's bilingual manual. Before disabling or uninstalling, empty chip racks and gun cabinets; turn off optional ingot recipes, then load and save once.
